Sobre a Zippi

Estamos na missão de impulsionar os 22 milhões de micro e pequenos negócios (MPEs) no Brasil com soluções financeiras que realmente atendem às suas necessidades.

Fomos pioneiros no uso do PIX como plataforma de crédito, permitindo que MPEs acessem capital de giro de forma instantânea. Com apenas um toque, nossos clientes conseguem pagar despesas do negócio e ainda contar com até 10 dias para pagar, garantindo um fluxo de caixa consistente para suas operações.

Desde o nosso lançamento, há quatro anos, alcançamos a lucratividade e vivemos um período de crescimento exponencial. Até hoje, já concedemos mais de R$ 10 bilhões em crédito para micro e pequenos negócios em todo o Brasil. Estamos escalando rapidamente para nos tornarmos a principal solução de capital de giro no mercado brasileiro de MPBs, que movimenta cerca de R$ 3,5 trilhões por ano. Assim como os cartões de crédito transformaram o consumo, a Zippi está redefinindo a forma como os pequenos negócios gerenciam seu fluxo de caixa — com acesso instantâneo, integração fluída e soluções construídas para necessidades reais do dia a dia.

Nosso sucesso é impulsionado por uma abordagem altamente automatizada e baseada em dados. Construímos uma infraestrutura tecnológica avançada, capaz de processar grandes volumes de dados de pagamentos e crédito, o que nos permite realizar a análise de risco, a liberação e a cobrança de crédito em escala, mantendo unit economics sólidos. Gerenciamos todo o ciclo de crédito internamente, alavancando ciência de dados de ponta para tomar decisões em tempo real com alto nível de precisão.

Com o apoio de investidores de alto nível, como Y Combinator e Tiger Global, formamos um time de tecnologia de calibre global focado em construir um futuro em que todo pequeno negócio no Brasil possa prosperar. Se você busca a oportunidade de gerar impacto real em uma causa que vale a pena, em uma das startups que mais crescem em mercados emergentes, atuando em uma oportunidade multibilionária — a Zippi é o lugar certo para você.

Sobre o Time

O time de Finanças da Zippi é responsável por garantir que a companhia cresça com solidez, controle e eficiência. Atuamos de forma próxima aos founders e às áreas de negócio, participando diretamente das decisões que impactam a saúde financeira e a estratégia da empresa.

Hoje, não temos uma pessoa dedicada à área fiscal. As obrigações estão distribuídas entre Controladoria e BPO externo, e com o crescimento acelerado e a Reforma Tributária em andamento chegou a hora de internalizar essa função com protagonismo e profundidade técnica.

Sua Missão

Você será a primeira referência tributária da Zippi, responsável por estruturar e conduzir a governança fiscal da empresa em um momento de crescimento e transformação regulatória.

Suas principais frentes de atuação serão:

1. Gestão das Obrigações Acessórias: assumir a gestão operacional de todas as obrigações federais, garantindo entregas precisas e dentro dos prazos regulatórios. Isso inclui SPED Fiscal, SPED Contribuições, ECF, ECD, DCTF, DCTF-Web, EFD-Reinf e DES-IF.

2. Reforma Tributária: liderar a preparação da Zippi para os impactos da Reforma Tributária nas obrigações acessórias, com foco em DeRE e Split Payment, mapeando o que muda, definindo processos e garantindo conformidade desde o início.

3. Estruturação e Governança Fiscal: mapear gaps, definir o sistema fiscal a ser utilizado, participar da sua implementação e construir rotinas e processos que escalam com o crescimento da empresa.

O que buscamos

  • Domínio de obrigações acessórias federais: SPED Fiscal, SPED Contribuições, ECF, ECD, DCTF, DCTF-Web, EFD-Reinf e DES-IF;
  • Conhecimento de obrigações BACEN (CADOCs, plano de contas COSIF);
  • Conhecimento sobre os impactos da Reforma Tributária nas obrigações acessórias, com foco em DeRE e Split Payment;
  • Formação em Contabilidade;
  • Mínimo de 6 anos de experiência na área fiscal;
  • Experiência em empresa regulada pelo BACEN.

Por que vir para a Zippi?

  • Uma causa pela qual vale a pena lutar: nossa missão é ajudar micro e pequenas empresas a prosperar. Seu trabalho impactará diretamente 22 milhões de empreendedores brasileiros, ampliando o acesso financeiro em um mercado enorme e carente de soluções.
  • Ownership e construção desde o primeiro dia: como o primeiro Tax da Zippi, você terá papel essencial na estruturação de uma área estratégica em uma startup lucrativa, bem financiada e apoiada por investidores de renome como Y Combinator, Tiger Global e Globo Ventures.
  • Aprendizado acelerado com gente boa: aqui você terá a oportunidade de se envolver em projetos estratégicos e enfrentar desafios complexos ao lado de fundadores e operadores de fintechs de ponta. Nossos times são colaborativos, atuam com autonomia e carregam um alto grau de responsabilidade.

O que você pode esperar da gente!

  • Remuneração na faixa alta de mercado;
  • Learning Budget anual;
  • Plano de Saúde 100% pago pela Zippi para você e para dependentes até 18 anos. Para cônjuges e companheiros(as), cobrimos 50% da mensalidade;
  • Auxílio-creche para crianças até 6 anos;
  • Vale-refeição no Caju;
  • Férias flexíveis;
  • Wellhub e Zenklub;
  • Trabalho 100% remoto.

mbaexchange-lightspeed-hq:ashbyhq:433c1e.descriptionHtml:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

Lightspeed is looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Analyst to join our Global Revenue Planning & Reporting team. In this role, you'll be a critical partner to our Go-to-Market organization - owning the reporting infrastructure, surfacing insights that drive commercial decisions, and setting the standard for data quality and analytical rigor across the business.

This is a high-visibility role for someone who thrives at the intersection of data, strategy, and cross-functional influence. If you're energized by turning complex, ambiguous problems into clear recommendations - and you take pride in the reliability of your work - we want to hear from you.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Own GTM reporting - design, build, and maintain dashboards and reports in Looker that serve Sales, Marketing, and Finance stakeholders; continuously raise the bar on accuracy, clarity, and production efficiency

  • Be the analytical authority - translate complex business questions into structured analyses; go beyond the numbers to deliver actionable recommendations backed by clear narrative

  • Drive data integrity - identify gaps in upstream business processes that affect reporting accuracy; partner with stakeholders to implement corrective measures before problems compound

  • Collaborate on data modeling - work closely with our corporate data team to design and maintain GTM datasets that are reliable and scalable across operational and strategic use cases

  • Support planning and forecasting - leverage Pigment to contribute to revenue planning cycles and scenario modeling

  • Synthesize for leadership - distill complex findings into concise, compelling stories for senior stakeholders; know what to emphasize and what to cut

  • Lead ad hoc strategic projects - assess new business activities, process changes, or operational questions as they arise; bring structure and speed to ambiguous problems

What you need to bring:

We’re a global team of 5 people located in North America. The Revenue Operations team is core to the success of our go-to-market functions. 

We're looking for an Intermediate candidate who has experience with the following:

  • 5+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Intelligence, or a related analytical role

  • Deep hands-on experience with Looker

  • Strong working knowledge of Salesforce - including reporting, and pipeline management

  • Proven ability to work across GTM, Finance,, and Data teams to drive cross-functional outcomes

  • Strong SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets

  • A track record of translating analytical output into business decisions 

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Analytics, Commerce or a related field

  • Familiarity with Pigment, Spiff, and Monday.com is a plus

  • As a global company with employees and clients outside of Quebec, fluency in English as a working language is required for this position.

We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!

Be a changemaker

You’ll enjoy:

  • A flexible work environment that empowers you to do your best work

  • A culture that celebrates performance

  • The chance to make an impact in a team that’s big enough for career growth, but lean enough to make your voice heard

  • Career-defining opportunities

Plus benefits designed to keep you happy, healthy and fulfilled.

  • Flexible paid time off and remote work policies 

  • Equity options, because this is your company too

  • Contributions to your pension plan. Your future matters

  • Training opportunities to grow your skills and career

  • Health and wellness credit so you feel your best

  • Time off to volunteer and give back to your community

  • Interest groups, employee led networks, social committees to sponsored sports teams

  • Computer purchase program to get your personal Macbook

  • Enhanced parental leave to support growing families

Fuel your growth. Find your people.

At Lightspeed, your growth is our priority. We invest in you with continuous learning opportunities, global mobility and benefits designed to support you—all within a driven, diverse and inclusive team that’s passionate about empowering our communities

At Lightspeed, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your skill set, qualifications, experience, and market data. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We reasonably expect the total compensation for this position to be in the range of $75,000 - $85,000CAD. Lightspeed also provides a variety of employee benefits including, but not limited to, medical, dental, wellness, life and disability insurance, RRSP plan and match, paid parental leave top-up, and paid time off.Please note that this compensation information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within Ontario and reflects the amount Lightspeed is willing to pay at the time of this posting. This role represents an existing vacancy at Lightspeed. Lightspeed uses artificial intelligence–enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process; all hiring decisions are made by our recruiting and hiring teams.

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. About the Role

We are seeking a commercially-minded, customer-facing Solution Consultant / Sales Engineer to influence and drive revenue growth across the North of England. In this role, you will be the ultimate technical partner to our Field Sales reps. You will use your expertise to position and demonstrate Lightspeed’s platform to a range of hospitality customers, helping our sales team get deals over the line.

This is a pre-sales commercial role, focused on winning new business and positioning value. You will use your deep understanding of the hospitality industry alongside your technical acumen to solve business hurdles for prospects and build ultimate customer confidence during the sales cycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Sales Partnership & Deal Influence: Partner closely with Account Executives to co-own the technical strategy for complex sales opportunities. Conduct high-impact, on-site discoveries and tailored product demonstrations that directly increase win rates.

  • Regional Field Mobility: Actively travel across the North of England and the Midlands to meet hospitality prospects on-site, operating with high autonomy in customer-facing environments.

  • Commercial Value Positioning: Translate complex technical features (software, hardware, APIs) into tangible business value and ROI for restaurateurs and hospitality operators.

  • Industry & Competitive Expertise: Maintain an acute understanding of the hospitality tech landscape. Act as a trusted advisor to prospects, helping sales teams effectively differentiate Lightspeed from regional competitors.

  • Technical Risk Assessment: Identify potential technical blockers or integration constraints early in the sales cycle to ensure we are setting up both the customer and our implementation teams for long-term success.

  • Trade Shows and Industry Events: Represent the company as the technical and product expert at major hospitality trade shows, engaging prospects and supporting the field team with live environments.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Act as the bridge between the field and internal teams, ensuring clear documentation of customer requirements for a smooth handoff to Implementation once the deal is won.

What You Need to Bring (Requirements)

Sales & Hospitality Experience:

  • Commercial Sales Background: Demonstrated experience working directly within a sales process (e.g., as a Sales Engineer, Pre-Sales Consultant, or Tech-Savvy Account Executive). You understand sales methodologies and how to help move a prospect from interest to decision.

  • Hospitality DNA: A strong, deep understanding of the hospitality industry (restaurants, hotels, bars) and the unique operational challenges operators face. Direct experience working in hospitality, or selling technology into hospitality, is highly required.

  • Commercial Focus: A mindset centered on value creation, persuasion and solution-design.

Travel & Logistics:

  • Mobility: A valid UK driving license and access to a vehicle are essential.

  • Flexibility: Genuine willingness to travel regularly across the North of England and Midlands for on-site customer deep-dives.

Technical Competencies:

  • Solution Mindset: Strong aptitude for cloud-based SaaS, APIs, and integrations, with the ability to explain complex technical workflows simply to independent restaurant owners or C-level hospitality executives.

  • Communication Excellence: Exceptional relationship-building skills, with the ability to command a room and collaborate seamlessly with internal sales reps.

mbaexchange-palantir:lever:16a1b500-13fe.descriptionHtml:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role
 
Our Deal Team members collaborate with multiple Palantir teams to proactively engage with existing and prospective commercial customers, leading the structuring and negotiation of deal terms so that Palantir can continue to drive positive impact in the world.

As a member of the Deal Team, you will partner closely with Palantir’s Legal, Finance, Sales, and Engineering teams to drive deal execution and support our growth efforts at scale, while directly owning the development and negotiation of commercial terms for commercial customers. You will use your expertise to unite our customer’s needs and considerations with our company’s strategy, using your creativity to identify the right commercial structure and approach for each customer. You will also utilize your understanding of the business landscape and build relationships with internal partners, increasing the visibility of deal progress and forecasting impact across all levels of our organization, from analysts to C-suite executives.

In this role, you will also support various special projects that arise at our fast-paced, mission-focused company. We’re a team that values both creativity and teamwork. Whether operating solo or collaboratively, we endeavor to achieve great results on challenging, time-sensitive deal discussions and projects.

You'll be given open ended objectives and expected to find ways to turn them into outcomes. By focusing on the broad vision without losing sight of the details, you'll bring large and multi-phase deals to successful completion while prioritizing team outcomes over individual wins. You are able to deliver complex commercial contract and deal information in an understandable way, and can manage high touch stakeholders in a constantly shifting landscape. You are ready to become an expert on the intricate details of deal negotiations and contracts that enable Palantir to implement its cutting-edge technology to solve real-world problems.
  • Collaborate with Sales counterparts to develop the pricing terms and commercial structure for each commercial customer.
  • Lead negotiations of commercial terms during the contracting process, guiding communications as appropriate for the situation.
  • Draft materials in support of deal negotiations, including pricing proposals, term sheets and order forms, while advising the business on commercial structure implications including revenue impact and timing.
  • Cooperate with internal Legal, Finance, Sales and Engineering teams to drive deals to execution, providing trusted guidance for navigating negotiations and procurement processes and maintaining engagement throughout the customer lifecycle to develop and negotiate commercial terms for renewal and up-sell opportunities.
  • Ensure alignment of individual deal terms with company-wide strategy, while also addressing individual customer needs and considerations.
  • Partner with Finance team to provide leadership with visibility of deal progress and forecasting impact.
  • Present the results of our work and proposals for new deals to audiences ranging from analysts to C-suite executives, and distill your experiences with individual customers into suggested improvements for deal structures and contract terms.
  • Experience drafting materials in deal negotiations such as pricing proposals, order forms, and contracts.
  • Demonstrated experience approaching problems creatively and analytically.
  • Ability to build strong relationships and collaborate both with a cross-functional team and with customers, leveraging effective communication as well as strong writing and customer service skills .
  • Strong program/project management skills, including the ability to handle multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment, and meet deadlines with minimal supervision or administrative support.
  • Adaptive, empathetic, and introspective; willing to learn, teach, lead and follow.
  • Willingness and ability to work outside of standard business hours as needed.
  • 5+ years of commercial contracting, drafting or partnership negotiation experience; experience negotiating SaaS or other technology agreements is a definite plus.
  • Education: Master of Business Administration (MBA) or Juris Doctor (JD) degree, with preference of JD.
    • Salary
     
    The estimated salary range for this position is estimated to be $135,000 - $200,000/year. Total compensation for this position may also include Restricted Stock units, sign-on bonus, and other potential future incentives. Further note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual’s relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors. This estimate excludes the value of any potential sign-on bonus; the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long-term incentives.

    Our benefits aim to promote health and wellbeing across all areas of Palantirians’ lives. We work to continuously improve our offerings and listen to our community as we design and update them. The list below details our available benefits and some of the perks that can be enjoyed as an employee of Palantir Technologies.
     
    Benefits
     
    •  Employees (and their eligible dependents) can enroll in medical, dental, and vision insurance as well as voluntary life insurance
    •  Employees are automatically covered by Palantir’s basic life, AD&D and disability insurance
    •  Commuter benefits
    •  Take what you need paid time off, not accrual based
    •  2 weeks paid time off built into the end of each year (subject to team and business needs)
    •  10 paid holidays throughout the calendar year
    •  Supportive leave of absence program including time off for military service and medical events
    •  Paid leave for new parents and subsidized back-up care for all parents
    •  Fertility and family building benefits including but not limited to adoption, surrogacy, and preservation
    •  Stipend to help with expenses that come with a new child
    •  Employees can enroll in Palantir’s 401k plan
     
    Life at Palantir
     
    We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region.
     
    In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the state in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.
     
    If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer for all, including but not limited to Veterans and those with disabilities. mbaexchange-paytm:lever:a39d765c-2623-4b.descriptionHtml:
About Paytm Group: Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm's mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the Role: Paytm Money is looking for a strategic and growth-driven Business Head – Mutual Funds & NFO to lead one of the most critical charters within our wealth business. This role will own the complete Mutual Fund and New Fund Offer (NFO) business, including business strategy, product growth, partnerships, customer acquisition, revenue acceleration, platform innovation, and market expansion. The ideal leader will bring deep expertise in mutual fund distribution, passive and active investment products, investor behavior, AMC partnerships, and digital wealth ecosystems, while building a scalable business that democratizes investing for millions of Indians. This is not just a distribution leadership role. It is an opportunity to define the next phase of retail investing by building India’s most intelligent, accessible, and high-growth MF platform.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Business Ownership & P&L Leadership
* Own end-to-end P&L for the Mutual Funds and NFO business
* Define annual and long-term growth strategy
* Drive topline growth, profitability, customer expansion, and AUM scale
* Build category growth roadmap across: Equity Mutual Funds, Debt Funds, Hybrid Funds, Index Funds, ETFs, International Funds, Thematic / Sectoral Funds

2. NFO Strategy & Execution
* Lead the complete NFO business charter
* Identify high-potential fund launches and build GTM strategy
* Drive subscription volumes across marquee NFO launches
* Partner with AMCs for exclusive campaigns and launches
* Build strong investor education and conversion funnels around NFO participation

3. Growth & Customer Acquisition
* Drive MF investor acquisition at scale
* Improve SIP activation, repeat investment behavior, and retention
* Design high-conversion journeys for: First-time investors, Passive investors, Existing equity users cross-selling into MF
* Build lifecycle programs to improve customer stickiness

4. Product & Platform Innovation
* Partner closely with Product and Engineering to build category-leading investment experiences including: SIP innovation, Goal-based investing journeys, Fund recommendation engines, Portfolio insights, Smart asset allocation tools, Risk profiling frameworks & MF comparison and discovery experience

5. AMC & Ecosystem Partnerships
* Build and strengthen strategic relationships with: Leading Asset Management Companies, Registrar & Transfer Agents, Market infrastructure partners, Distribution ecosystem stakeholders, Drive commercial partnerships, co-marketing opportunities, and exclusive launches.

6. Analytics & Business Intelligence
* Own metrics across: AUM growth, SIP book expansion, Investor activation, NFO conversion, Redemption trends, Retention and cohort behavior
* Leverage analytics to build sharper acquisition and monetization strategies.

7. Market Intelligence & Competitive Strategy
* Track industry shifts across: Passive investing trends, Regulatory developments, Competitor product innovation, Investor behavior evolution
* Translate insights into business opportunities.

8. Team Leadership
* Build and lead high-performing teams across: Business, Partnerships, Growth, Category management, Analytics
* Create a culture of speed, ownership, and customer obsession.

What We’re Looking For:
* Experience - 12–18 years of experience in: Wealth-tech, Broking, Mutual fund distribution, Asset management& Consumer fintech

Domain Expertise:
* Deep understanding of: Mutual fund ecosystem, SIP and systematic investing behavior, NFO lifecycle and GTM, Distribution economics, Retail investor acquisition, Capital markets and investment products

Leadership Capabilities:
* Strong business ownership mindset
* P&L management
* Strategic thinking with execution excellence
* Cross-functional influence
* Data-driven decision making

nightdragon-human:ashbyhq:6cbac1d0-843d-.descriptionHtml:
HUMAN Security is seeking a proactive, strategic Procurement Manager to help build out and scale our Strategic Sourcing & Procurement function.

Reporting directly to the SVP of FP&A, you will lead our Procurement function across a $50M+ spend base, and will serve as a key business partner to Finance, Legal, Security, IT and functional budget owners. You will own the full procurement lifecycle across software, SaaS, cloud marketplace purchases, marketing, professional services, contractors, and other G&A categories, while helping HUMAN improve spend visibility, reduce risk, drive savings, and streamline the purchasing experience.

This is an exciting opportunity for a strategically focused, detail-oriented operator who wants to shape the long-term strategic sourcing roadmap while optimizing vendor relationships, contracts, and spend.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the company’s end-to-end procurement cycle including requirements gathering, commercial evaluation, negotiation, contracting, and PO execution.

  • Manage existing supplier & reseller relationships, renewals, and performance.

  • Partner with department leaders to anticipate, plan, and forecast purchasing needs in advance of renewals and new investments.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to Finance, Legal, IT Security - partnering with each team to ensure a pain-free procurement process that is balanced with protection of HUMAN’s legal, commercial, and InfoSec positions.

  • Help optimize cloud marketplace and alternative purchasing paths where relevant, including tracking committed-spend usage and improving how marketplace purchases are evaluated and managed.

  • Identify and execute opportunities for savings, supplier consolidation, process simplification, improved contract terms, and better usage alignment.

  • Manage the company’s procurement management tool and use data analytics and AI tools to drive better decisions and streamline procurement policies & workflows.

  • Improve spend visibility, renewal tracking, vendor performance monitoring, and procurement KPI reporting across the procurement lifecycle.

Who you are:

  • Proven leadership experience in technology procurement, strategic sourcing, and vendor management, owning the full procurement lifecycle.

  • Experience implementing and managing procurement tools and contract management platforms (e.g., Tropic, Zip, Ironclad/Docusign,).

  • Experience with cloud marketplace procurement, committed-spend optimization, or alternative software buying channels.

  • Strong analytical and financial skill set, with the ability to evaluate spend data, build business cases, and translate analysis into clear recommendations.

  • Excellent negotiation skills with a track record of driving cost savings and value through complex agreements.

  • Deep expertise in system consolidation, technology budgeting, forecasting, and KPI management related to technology procurement.

  • Exceptional communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence at all organizational levels.

  • Self-motivated and entrepreneurial mindset with a dedication to high standards of operational excellence and data accuracy.

About HUMAN Security

HUMAN was founded in a Brooklyn sci-fi bookstore with a hacker mindset and the lofty mission of making the internet safer by putting humans first. Today, our Human Defense Platform safeguards enterprises from sophisticated bots, fraud, and account abuse, verifying the humanity of more than 20 trillion interactions per week for the world’s biggest brands and internet platforms.

HUMAN is an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to protecting the internet's integrity for everyone. We believe in putting people first, embracing diversity of thought from our global teams, and welcoming all individuals to share their unique experiences as we fight cybercrime together. We support our Humans with a comprehensive total rewards package for personal and professional development, including well-being and learning stipends, flexible work options, and dedicated time off. While our HQ is in NYC, we have teams worldwide.

HUMAN is growing fast, and there’s never been a more meaningful time to join us. If you thrive on solving complex problems and want to help shape the future of cybersecurity, join us as we build a safer, more human internet.

If you are an individual with a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us directly.

pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:d8b852b5-f083-421.descriptionHtml:
About Abacus

Abacus is reinventing how accounting firms operate by building AI agents that automate the tedious, repetitive workflows that teams currently face. Our core engine combines advanced OCR and LLMs to deliver truly intelligent back-office automation. We're already working with large enterprise clients, generating meaningful revenue, and backed by top-tier investors. We’ve accomplished all of this as a team of two, and we’re excited to grow our team. If you want to shape the future of AI-powered operations and own meaningful technical work from day one, this is the place.

The Role

We're hiring our first Founding Engineer to own and expand the core machine learning engine behind Abacus. You’ll report directly to the co-founders and work in person from our SF office. This is a rare opportunity to join a high-growth company as an early engineer with massive autonomy and influence over product and technical direction.

In your first 3–6 months, you’ll:

  • Improve and scale our ML extraction engine using LLMs and OCR

  • Own backend architecture and infrastructure decisions

  • Build and ship greenfield features to expand the workflows we automate

Over the next year, you'll help lay the groundwork for our engineering org as we scale, while staying hands-on and focused on impact.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead development of our ML-powered document extraction engine

  • Architect backend systems with performance and scalability in mind

  • Build and deploy new automation features for tax firms

  • Collaborate closely with the founders on product and user needs

  • Help define our engineering culture and technical roadmap

What We're Looking For

Must-haves:

  • 1–5 years of experience, ideally in high-ownership or early-stage environments

  • Strong backend development skills, particularly in Python

  • Proven 0→1 builder (side projects, startup experience, or both)

  • Willingness to work from our SF office, 5 days/week

  • Willingness to complete a technical take-home exercise as part of the process

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with LLMs, OCR, or data extraction systems

  • Exposure to AI infrastructure or evaluation frameworks

Why Join Us

  • No ceiling on ownership or growth

  • Significant equity and high-leverage role at a fast-growing startup

  • Top-tier health insurance, daily lunches, and an in-office barista

  • You’ll help define the trajectory of the product, team, and company!

qedinvestors-zopa:lever:3f8d501e-e4c8-48.descriptionHtml:
Our Story
 
Hello there. We’re Zopa.
 
We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com! 

We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces. 

If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife

The team:
Developer Experience (DevX) is the heart of engineering productivity at Zopa. We are a high-impact squad of 6 engineers who treat our internal platform as a product, and our fellow Zopa engineers as our customers. 
 
Our mission is to build the tools that let every product engineer maintain compliance whilst having a world-class experience in shipping their code. We are currently starting a landmark project migrating our entire Fintech infrastructure from self-hosted Jenkins to a SaaS-based GitHub Actions platform.  
 
You will work across a modern stack including Go, AWS, Kubernetes (EKS), ArgoCD, Terraform, Vault, Honeycomb and DX.
 
Key requirements for the role are:
  1. Strong customer centric mindset with proven experience
  2. Leading migration massive plus but proven GitHub Actions pipeline design at scale experience is essential
 
A day in the life:
As a Senior DevX Engineer, your focus isn't on deploying software for teams, fixing their pipelines, or troubleshooting incidents; you are architecting the future of how Zopa builds software. You will spend 50-80% of your time writing high-quality code to build internal CLI tools, automation providers, and self-service platforms. 
 
The rest of your day is spent as a strategic consultant and leader. You’ll be: 
 
- Architecting the Platform Evolution: Designing the templates and workflows that will move hundreds of microservices onto GitHub Actions. 
- Stakeholder Engagement: Meeting with product squads to identify friction points and writing technical RFCs to solve them. 
- Data-Driven Optimization: Analyzing DORA/DX metrics to prove that your tools have increased delivery experience (speed, stability, flow). 
- Mentoring: Levelling up our mid-level and associate engineers through pairing and high-standard code reviews. 
  • Programming Knowledge: You'll spend time writing high-quality Go code to build APIs, CLIs, tools and automation providers, but we are open to anyone with a deep knowledge of a similar language (Java, Kotlin, .Net) 
  • Platform Visionary: You don’t just "deploy stuff for people"; you build the self-service platforms that allow people to easily deploy stuff for themselves. 
  • CI/CD Specialist: Deep, production-level experience with GitHub Actions and Jenkins is essential. You’ve ideally navigated a migration between the two before. 
  • Infrastructure Native: You are a power user of Kubernetes and AWS (including Lambdas). You understand the "why" behind the architecture, not just the "how." 
  • Proactive Communicator: You are comfortable presenting to stakeholders, writing clear documentation, and acting as the "face" of the DevX team. 
  • The "Product" Mindset: You have experience with measuring success based on quantitative and qualitative metrics (developer sentiment, speed, cost), not by tickets closed. 
  • Languages: Advanced-level Go would be ideal but not mandatory. Familiarity with Java, Kotlin, or .NET is a plus. 
  • Orchestration: Advanced Kubernetes, ArgoCD, and Terraform. 
  • Tooling: Experience with Vault, Knative, and observability tools like Splunk, and Honeycomb. 
  • Metrics: A track record of using data to drive engineering improvements (Platforms like GetDX or LinearB). 
  • Experience in high-growth startups or tech-first organizations   
  • Contributions to open-source DevX or CNCF projects. 
    • #LI-ON1

    At Zopa we value flexible ways of working.
    We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our London office 2-3 days a week.
     
    You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one.

    *Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice

    Diversity Statement
    Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments.

remotely-hive-ai:lever:c5101a9b-965e-4f4.descriptionHtml:
About Hive 

Hive is the leading provider of cloud-based AI solutions to understand, search, and generate content, and is trusted by hundreds of the world's largest and most innovative organizations. The company empowers developers with a portfolio of best-in-class, pre-trained AI models, serving billions of customer API requests every month. Hive also offers turnkey software applications powered by proprietary AI models and datasets, enabling breakthrough use cases across industries. Together, Hive’s solutions are transforming content moderation, brand protection, sponsorship measurement, context-based ad targeting, and more.

Hive has raised over $120M in capital from leading investors, including General Catalyst, 8VC, Glynn Capital, Bain & Company, Visa Ventures, and others. We have over 250 employees globally in our San Francisco, Seattle, and Delhi offices. Please reach out if you are interested in joining the future of AI!

Security Engineer 

We are looking for a highly motivated individual with information security experience who is willing to collaborate with others to build the best in class security program. As a Security Engineer at Hive, you will work to protect sensitive company information, handle potential data breaches, and implement strong security and data governance controls. You will work at multiple levels within the organization to lead and participate in security operations, risk assessments, incident responses, and project maintenance. Our ideal candidate should be able to work cross functionally with engineering teams to help deliver on product objectives and drive foundational changes in order to improve the overall security posture of the company. A passion for AI is a must. 
  • Engineer, implement and monitor security measures for the protection of computer systems, networks and information
  • Identify and define system security requirements
  • Partner with multiple engineering teams on internal and customer-facing security and privacy initiatives while ensuring that security data accessibility, quality, and reliability are taken into account
  • Analyze our security posture, identify gaps/potential vulnerabilities, and work closely with other teams to ensure strong operational security by conducting security tests 
  • Design computer security architecture and develop detailed cyber security designs
  • Write comprehensive reports including assessment-based findings, outcomes and propositions for further system security enhancement
  • Maintain awareness of industry best practices for data maintenance handling as it relates to your role
  • Adhere to policies, guidelines and procedures pertaining to the protection of information assets
  • Report actual or suspected security and/or policy violations/breaches to an appropriate authority
  • B.S. degree in Computer Science or related field
  • Proven work experience as a System Security Engineer or Information Security Engineer
  • Experience in building and maintaining security systems
  • Hands on experience in security systems, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, anti-virus software, authentication systems, log management, content filtering, etc
  • Ability to communicate in a written and oral format to technical and non-technical audiences in a business-friendly manner
  • Experience with network security and networking technologies and with system, security, and network monitoring tools
  • Thorough understanding of the latest security principles, techniques, and protocols
  • Problem solving skills and ability to work under pressure
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented; can handle multiple projects and dynamic priorities without missing a beat
    • Who We Are

    We are a group of ambitious individuals who are passionate about creating a revolutionary AI company. At Hive, you will have a steep learning curve and an opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest growing AI start-ups in San Francisco. The work you do here will have a noticeable and direct impact on the development of the company.

    Thank you for your interest in Hive and we hope to meet you soon!

    The current expected base salary for this position ranges from $100,000 - $180,000. Actual compensation may vary depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. Base pay is one part of the total compensation package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work; stock options may be offered in addition to the range provided here.

sequoia-outreach-io:lever:8c7afc59-f6cc-.descriptionHtml:
About Outreach
 
Outreach, founded in 2014, is the only complete agentic AI platform for revenue teams. Outreach infuses agentic AI, conversation intelligence, and assistive AI to power hundreds of use cases across revenue motions. From new logo prospecting to expansions, deal acceleration, driving retention, and forecasting, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions. Revenue leaders benefit from connected account visibility, performance insights, and higher forecasting accuracy across every GTM team. World leading enterprise organizations use Outreach to power their revenue teams, including Databricks, SAP, Siemens, and Verizon to name a few. 

About the Team  
 
The Intelligence Tooling & Enablement is a new internal-facing platform team dedicated to introducing and enabling various AI based solutions to the entire engineering organization. This Team will be focused on defining a vision and modernize software development process by creating services, adjusting processes, documentation, or whatever else is helpful in order to transform Outreach Engineering into an AI first organization. This wide and intentionally vague charter encompasses a slew of evolving topics. We try to proactively get ahead and build the tooling, systems, and training needed for all our engineering teams to adopt a new era of software development and set them up for success by improving development workflow. 

 

Primary areas of coverage:  

  • Build AI solutions and integrate into development life cycle 

  • Evaluate new AI solutions appearing on the market 

  • introduce tooling for administration such as performance or AI credit consumption monitoring   

  • Defining and tracking operational excellence standards  

  • The charter is wide, the opportunities for organizational impact are boundless, and we have your back to try new things and see if they stick and do, in fact, make everyone more efficient. 
     

The Role  
 
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Software Engineer to contribute as part of this new team to help offer a great service and experience to their fellow colleagues in the other feature engineering teams. Here you are expected to have a real impact on the engineering platform, helping evolve our technology stack and build reusable components that help the other backend teams. 
 
This role will pave the way to improving the developer experience by creating internal frameworks, SDKs, pipelines, and platforms that accelerate the entire AI development lifecycle. 
 
If a wide leeway to improve developer productivity and production reliability sounds exciting to you, come talk to us!

  • Directly contributing to the vision, strategy and roadmap for the Intelligent Tooling and Enablement Team 

  • Driving excellence by providing quality code, performance, maintainability 

  • Identifying common themes in upcoming projects and building common frameworks to help teams build them faster  

  • Working with engineering teams to find out where we need to invest in more tooling  

  • Triaging feedback and bugs from users  

  • Engaging with the open-source community  

  • Building reliable core service libraries so feature teams can focus on business logic 

  • Experience maintaining shared libraries, especially open-source libraries 

  • Experience with container-based workflows and services, especially Kubernetes 

  • Experience building production monitoring to track service and website health 

  • Experience with Golang (used extensively by the Dev Tooling team) 

  • Familiarity with Typescript, Python, and Ruby (used elsewhere in the company) 

  • Hands-on experience with AI coding assistants, AI-based testing tools, and automation frameworks used in modern software engineering. 

  • Familiarity with modern AI technologies such as LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, model evaluation, and AI-assisted development tools. 

  • Strong knowledge of development workflows including planning, coding, testing, CI/CD, and deployment. 

  • Experience with modern cloud environments and AI infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP). 

  • Understanding of how to connect AI systems with enterprise data sources (documentation systems, code repositories, ticketing systems). 

Why You’ll Love It Here
 
• Flexible time off
• 401k to help you save for the future
• Generous medical, dental, and vision coverage for full-time employees and their dependents
• A parental leave program that includes options for a paid night nurse, and a gradual return to work
• Infertility/ assisted reproductive services benefit
• Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team
• Snacks and beverages in the Office, along with fun events to celebrate
• Diversity and inclusion programs that promote employee resource groups like Outreach Women's Network, Latinx community, Outreach Black Connection, AAPI community, Pride/LGBTQIA+, Gender+, Disability Community, and Veterans/Military
 
Outreach is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
 
Our success is reliant on building teams that include people from different backgrounds and experiences who can elevate assumptions and ideas with fresh perspectives. We're dedicated to hiring the whole human, not just a resume. To that end, we look for a diverse pool of applicants-including those from historically marginalized groups. We would like to invite you to apply even if you don't think you meet all of the requirements listed below. We don't want a few lines in a job description to get between us and the opportunity to meet you.

serena-fipto:teamtailor:3f521442-8bd7-48.descriptionHtml:
Who Are We?

Fipto is a B2B cross-border payments platform that enables businesses to send and receive fiat and digital currencies instantly around the world through blockchain rails.

Our goal is to empower companies to effortlessly access financial services in a consistent, transparent, and secure way - regardless of the underlying requirements and technology.

To that end, we have developed a solution (both as an API and a platform) that allows for a unified management of digital and fiat currencies. Our commitment is to provide a user-friendly product and attentive customer service.

At Fipto, our growing team of 30 professionals is at the heart of our success. Together, we are shaping a workplace culture where collaboration, innovation, high standards, and quality define our daily endeavors. We offer each individual a dynamic work environment, fostering both success and continuous learning.

What is the role of Operations Analyst at Fipto?

As a Operations Analyst at Fipto, you will work closely with Marine our senior MO/BO and Bertrand our COO, our Sales team, our compliance team and our product team to ensure the smooth running of customer transactions. Your main role will be to manage and configure client accounts. Moreover, you'll be in charge of onboarding and monitoring customer transactions, as well as ensuring that every financial entry in our ledger is properly reconciled in Fipto's books.

Here are your missions:

  • Analyze our corporate clients' files (KYB/KYC) and analyze their risk from a compliance point of view and perform the periodic reviews

  • Monitor transactions in crypto-currencies and traditional currencies to manage fraud risks, as well as regulatory compliance risks.

  • Manage settlements and deliveries with Fipto's liquidity partners.

  • Review and improve existing processes / create new ones.

  • Implement strategic recommendations on partnerships and customers.

  • Support Marine on project management side


Your Future Team:

You will work under Marine, your future manager and also our senior MO/BO.

You will also work closely with :

  • Bertrand our COO and co-founder and Chelsea our operation analyst

  • Gregoire, and Patrick, Fipto’s co-founders,

  • The Compliance Team, with Ivaylo and Lyazat,

  • The Sales team composed of Valentin, Charlotte, and one intern,

  • as well as many other people

About You:

  • Currently in your final year of a higher education course in management control, finance or auditing, you are currently talking a gap year or you’re looking for a 6-month end-of-studies internship from July 2026.

  • Ideally, you have previous successful experiences of a similar internship in a consulting firm or startup in strategy, finance or marketing.

  • You have an analytical mind and an ability to synthesize data.

  • You are meticulous, proactive and curious

  • You are autonomous, self-disciplined and able to question yourself.

  • You are results-oriented and data-driven

  • You speak both French and English fluently

  • You're a resourceful thinker

Recruitment Process:

  • Initial HR screening call with Sandra, Head of People and Culture (45 minutes, phone)

  • Case study at home (45 minutes)

  • Interview with our Senior Operations specialist, Marine (45 min, video or at the office)

  • Final interview with Bertrand, our COO (30 min, video or at the office)

Lastly, Gratification and Benefits of Joining Us: 

  • An attractive gratification

  • Two-day team building events two times a year to discuss Fipto vision, and bond as a team

  • And of course, a Swile Ticket Restaurant card and transportation assistance.

  • If what you've just read aligns with your plans for the future, then we look forward to receiving your application and meeting you.

    We respond within 24 hours.

    At Fipto, we are dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where every individual's unique background, perspective, and talent is valued and celebrated.

setventures-galvany:ashbyhq:02ce131c-8b6.title: (Senior) Product Manager - Venture Development (m/w/d)
setventures-galvany:ashbyhq:02ce131c-8b6.descriptionHtml:
At GALVANY, our goal is to make climate-neutral living a reality for everyone. We focus on execution – developing concrete, smart solutions and making heat pumps, battery storage, and smart metering easy to access, reliable, and affordable. GALVANY-Tech drives the energy transition through software. We're building an AI-based Operating System for sales, planning, installation and operation of heat pumps and integrated energy systems – from single-family homes to multi-unit buildings, and across our Energy Community as a Virtual Power Plant.

We are a profitable green-tech startup and believe that sustainable impact and long-term growth are only possible when grounded in a healthy business model. To implement our ambitious tech roadmap, we secured €10 million in seed funding from Set Ventures and AENU in the spring 2026. Driven by customer value, clarity, and responsibility, we stand for high-quality heating solutions and an environment where people take responsibility and drive lasting impact.

The Role

As Product Manager (m/w/d) in our Venture Products team, you drive new topics that emerge at the edge of our existing roadmap. Venture Products is GALVANY's speedboat taskforce inside Tech: a small, agile team that incubates new themes in short cycles and integrates them into the line organization once they are viable. You will not stay the long-term owner – you build, validate, hand over, and move on to the next speedboat.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the Incubate phase end-to-end: gather input from Tech Teams and from other stakeholder departments, consolidate it into a clear product hypothesis, and ship the first functional cut.

  • Formulate sharp hypotheses and validate them with small, fast experiments – tolerate ambiguity and turn it into clarity.

  • Act as the central cross-functional hub – bring tech and the rest of the company into alignment early, so that integration later is cheap, not expensive.

  • Plan and drive the Integrate phase: hand over knowledge, code, processes and responsibility cleanly to the receiving Tech Teams and departments – then let go.

  • Communicate transparently with Leadership and stakeholders – make phase transitions, risks and trade-offs visible; secure sponsorship for the next bet.

  • Be ready to start the next speedboat. Staying owner of an old topic forever is not part of the job.

Requirements

  • Experience. 5+ years of experience in high-performance environments (e.g. fast-scaling startups). Demonstrable end-to-end responsibility in software development is a plus.

  • Zero-to-One Track Record. Proven experience launching new products, business lines or major new initiatives from scratch – ideally inside a larger company (intrapreneurship, new BU, spin-out, greenfield).

  • Background. Strong background in relevant fields, e.g. Business, Engineering, Design, Communication, Computer Science, or similar.

  • Cross-Functional Breadth. You are comfortable working with Ops, Marketing, Customer Success and Finance – not just Engineering. You can switch context between a technical architecture discussion and a unit-economics conversation in the same morning.

  • Mindset. Self-driven, high ambiguity tolerance, comfortable with letting go of ownership – no need for micromanagement or specific tickets.

  • Technical Aptitude. Technical mindset with a passion for understanding systems, data flows, and integrations, coupled with enthusiasm for continuous learning and problem solving. Energy-Tech domain knowledge is a plus, not a requirement.

  • Language. Fluent in English; German is a plus.

Skills and Qualities That Are Important to Us

🚀 Outcome-Led. You focus on value over volume. You embrace iteration, adapt quickly to new information, and prioritize what moves the needle for business and user.

🧠 Systems Thinker. You see the bigger picture. You understand how a new initiative connects to the existing organization, products and processes – so that what you incubate can actually be integrated later.

⚡ Pragmatic. You choose the simplest effective path to solve problems – especially by leveraging AI tools.

🛶 Speedboat Operator. You start fast, go deep, hand over cleanly – and look forward to the next boat. You don't confuse ownership with attachment.

🏡 Customer Champion. You keep the end-user central in all decisions. You seek direct exposure to how customers experience the product, even on day one of a new initiative.

📊 Data-Informed Prioritizer. You use qualitative and quantitative signals to prioritize ruthlessly. You can articulate why not to build something – and when to kill a speedboat.

Benefits

  • Strong Growth & High Impact. A unique opportunity to join during a hypergrowth phase and actively contribute to company success.

  • Compensation. Competitive salary and flexible perks (sports, mobility, learning) tailored to your needs.

  • Real-World Impact. Your work drives decarbonization – measurable in CO₂ savings, energy efficiency (kWh), and cost reductions (€).

  • Office. Prime location in Berlin Charlottenburg, regular company events and all-hands. We value in-person collaboration and connection, while partial remote work remains an option.

  • No Corporate Theater. Skip endless alignment meetings, politics and waiting for permission. You talk to the people who matter and ship.

sorensoncap-safe-security:lever:7d447182.descriptionHtml:
Most boards and executives are currently flying blind when it comes to cyber risk. They are guessing. At Safe, we’ve built an AI-driven engine that finally gives the C-Suite a clear, quantified, and real-time view of their security posture. We don’t just provide data; we provide certainty.

We are a $170M Series C-funded category leader. We don’t play in the mid-market; we operate at the highest levels of global enterprise. Today, we are proud to serve 10% of the Fortune 500, protecting global icons such as Apple, Netflix, AT&T, Verizon, and Victoria’s Secret.

As we scale toward our next chapter, we are looking for high-performers who want to do the best work of their careers at the intersection of AI and Cybersecurity.

The Culture Memo: Our Operating System

Safe is not a typical corporate environment. We are a high-intensity, mission-driven team. We value builders who want to define a category and work alongside people who are equally committed to excellence.

  • Extreme Ownership: We don’t do "not my job." We hire people who see a gap and own the solution from start to finish.

  • The Elite Standard: We serve the most sophisticated companies on the planet. Our work must be bulletproof. Whether it’s a line of code or a sales deck, we aim for Tier-1 quality every time.

  • Methodology & Rigor: We don’t wing it. From Force Management and MEDDICC in sales to data-driven sprints in engineering, we rely on proven frameworks to stay disciplined and predictable.

  • Radical Candor: We move too fast for politics or sugar-coating. We value direct, honest feedback that helps us find the right answer quickly.

  • The Series C Hustle: We have the stability of a well-funded leader but the heart of a startup.

The Perks & Ownership:

We want our team to feel like owners because they are owners. We trust our people to manage their results and their time.

  • Meaningful Equity: Every "Safestar" is a shareholder. You aren’t just an employee; you are a partner in our success.

  • Unlimited Leaves: We don’t believe in clock-watching. We offer unlimited leave because we trust you to take the time you need to recharge while staying committed to the mission.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: We provide top-tier medical insurance and wellness benefits to ensure you and your family are well cared for.

  • Career Trajectory: We are growing aggressively. For high-performers, the path for advancement moves at the speed of your ambition.


Job Overview:
We are seeking an experienced and passionate Engineer to join our engineering team. As a senior engineer, you will lead a high-performing engineering team working closely with our Design, Product, and other stakeholders to develop and deliver core product features that help in predicting and preventing cyber breaches. 

Location: Bengaluru
  • Technical Leadership: Provide technical leadership and mentorship to a team of developers, promoting best practices, code quality, and continuous improvement.
  • Architecture and Design: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and architect scalable, secure, high-performance multi-tenant microservices.
  • Code Review: Conduct thorough code reviews to maintain code quality, identify opportunities for improvement, and share constructive feedback with team members.
  • Cloud Expertise: Leverage AWS services, including but not limited to AWS Lambda, API Gateway, EC2, S3, and RDS, to architect and optimize cloud-based solutions.
  • Problem Solving: Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, identifying root causes and implementing effective solutions.
  • Collaboration: Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment between technical solutions and business objectives.
  • Project Management: Lead the planning, execution, and successful delivery of features, ensuring they are completed on time and within scope.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Proven experience as a Lead Engineer or Senior Engineer of 5+ years with strong expertise in any server-side language such as NodeJs / Python / Go. 
  • Hands-on experience in API development using Typescript and frameworks such as Express is preferred.
  • Experience with modern web development technologies (e.g., React, Angular, Vue.js) is a plus.
  • Good understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases
  • Understanding of cloud computing concepts and experience using any major cloud service provider (AWS/GCP/Azure).
  • Ability to build and deploy the application in a containerized environment
  • Proven track record of delivering high-performance and scalable platforms in a fast-paced agile environment

startx-hive-health:ashbyhq:b545f522-7018.descriptionHtml:
Ready to make an impact? At Hive Health, we’re on a mission to make healthcare radically more accessible for all—and we need passionate, driven individuals to help us make it happen. If you thrive in a fast-paced, innovative environment and want to work on solutions that truly matter, we’d love to meet you!

Job Summary

The Medical Liaison serves as the key interface between members, healthcare providers, and the HMO teams.

The role is responsible for accurate processing of member availments, issuance of Letters of Authorization (LOAs), timely call handling, and efficient coordination of inquiries and cases to ensure high-quality service delivery.

Responsibilities

  1. Accurate and Efficient Adjudication of Member Availments and Issuance of LOA’s

  • Review and process member availments and claims in accordance with company policies, HMO guidelines, medical indication, and PhilHealth regulations.

  • Ensure Letters of Authorization (LOAs) are accurately prepared, approved, and issued in a timely manner or within ideal standards.

  • Identify and resolve problems concerning availments and LOA issuances to members.

  • Maintain complete and accurate data recording for auditing and utilization capture.

  • Discharge members efficiently ensuring all documentations and computations are complete and accurate.

  1. Maintain Effective Call Handling and Timely Log-in

  • Respond promptly and professionally to inbound calls from providers.

  • Provide accurate information regarding availments, benefits, and LOA’s.

  • Maintain daily log-in and call handling metrics in line with departmental standards.

  • Follow up on inquiries or escalated cases to ensure timely resolution.

3. Efficient Handling and Coordination of Inquiries and Cases

  • Serve as the main point of contact for providers regarding availments, LOAs, and member concerns.

  • Coordinate with healthcare providers and internal departments to resolve members’ inquiries and concerns

  • efficiently.

  • Track the progress of cases and ensure timely resolution.

  • Document interactions, updates, and outcomes in the concerned channels.

Qualifications

  • Must be willing to work hybrid in Ortigas

  • Must be willing to do occasional night shifts

  • Familiarity with medical indications for adjudication

  • Prior experience in roles such as medical liaison, provider relations, hospital HMO section staff, company nurse, teleconsult nurse, etc., is advantageous

  • Willingness to conduct hospital visits

  • Proficient problem-solving abilities

  • Curious, results-driven, ownership mentality with growth mindset

  • Excellent verbal and written communications

  • Collaborative team player with the ability to adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment

  • Passion for innovation in healthcare

Join our team as we revolutionalize healthcare in the Philippines—and beyond!

threshold-freshpaint:ashbyhq:87e72e22-19.descriptionHtml:
About Freshpaint:

Healthcare is a $4+ trillion industry in the U.S. alone, and it’s undergoing a rapid digital transformation.

Hospitals, digital health companies, and life sciences organizations rely on analytics and advertising tools to reach patients, measure performance, and grow. But those tools weren’t built for regulated healthcare data. That creates real compliance risk and forces teams to choose between growth and privacy.

Freshpaint eliminates that trade-off.

We’re a privacy-first data platform that helps healthcare organizations use modern marketing and analytics tools without exposing protected health information (PHI). Freshpaint sits between a company’s website or app and the third-party tools they use, automatically detecting and controlling sensitive data before it’s shared.

In short: we let healthcare teams move fast, safely.

Backed by Top Investors

Freshpaint is backed by some of the most respected names in technology, including:

  • Y Combinator (OpenAI, Stripe, Airbnb, Coinbase, DoorDash)

  • Intel Capital (Broadcom, Astera Labs, VMware, RedHat, MongoDB)

We’ve raised tens of millions of dollars in funding to build the privacy infrastructure layer for healthcare’s digital future.

What you’ll be doing

You will own the full lifecycle relationship for a book of Enterprise customers. You will help them navigate the healthcare data privacy landscape, adopt Freshpaint deeply across their stack, and expand their use of our platform over time. You will be directly responsible for net revenue retention across your accounts by driving adoption, renewals, and expansion while keeping customer outcomes at the center of every decision.

Primary responsibilities

  • Own net revenue retention and ARR across a book of ~25–40 Enterprise customers.

  • Build and execute account and value plans that drive product adoption, measurable outcomes, and expansion.

  • Lead renewals, upsells, and cross-sells, running a disciplined commercial process from early signals through close.

  • Run structured executive check-ins and QBRs that tie Freshpaint usage to business impact and future roadmap.

  • Use Freshpaint, Looker, and HubSpot to monitor health, forecast accurately, and prioritize where to engage.

  • Partner cross-functionally (Support, CSE, Product, Marketing, Partnerships, Sales) to remove blockers and unlock new value.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and voice of the customer, building deep relationships with champions and executive sponsors.

  • Travel up to 30% for onsite visits, conferences, and Freshpaint events.

Desired skills & experience

  • 7+ years in customer-facing roles in B2B SaaS (Account Management, Customer Success, or similar) working with Enterprise customers.

  • Proven track record of driving adoption, renewals, and expansion, with clear impact on net revenue retention.

  • Strong consultative skills: you uncover business problems, define success metrics, and map required capabilities to product value.

  • Data-driven and operationally excellent, with disciplined account planning, forecasting, and CRM hygiene.

  • Technically curious and comfortable translating between marketers, product managers, data teams, engineers, and executives.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including running business reviews and presenting to C-level audiences.

  • Thrives in a remote, early-stage, high-growth environment with high ownership and many moving pieces.

Nice to haves

  • Experience working with customer data, analytics, or marketing technology products.

  • Experience working directly with healthcare organizations such as Providers, Payers, Dental Support Organizations (DSOs), or Urgent Care groups.

  • Familiarity with HIPAA, healthcare data privacy, or other regulated industry frameworks.

  • Experience with analytics tools or warehouses (for example, Looker, Tableau, Snowflake, Redshift).

  • Exposure to common go-to-market frameworks such as MEDDIC or Command of the Message.

Perks & Benefits

We take care of our team—here’s a peek at what you get when you join:

  • Competitive pay + generous equity (10-year exercise window)

  • Fully remote (U.S. only) with a $150/month coworking stipend

  • Half-day Fridays, every Friday

  • 16 weeks fully paid parental leave (eligible after 6 months; commission-based roles receive 100% base salary during leave)

  • Unlimited PTO with a required 2-week minimum

  • Top-tier health, dental & vision (100% covered for you, 80% for dependents)

  • 2 “Treat Yourself” days a year—$100 and a day off, just because

  • Intentional & engaging company offsites 2x a year (past trips: Arizona, Jackson Hole, Cabo, Nashville, New Orleans & more) + a department offsite 1x per year

And more! Check out our careers page for the full list.
